C1558.title: ERC-4337 EntryPoint v0.9 Security Alert: initCode Behavior Change May Impact Account Security
C1558.summary: ERC-4337 EntryPoint v0.9 introduces a change where initCode is silently ignored instead of reverting if the account already exists. The official warning states that contracts previously assuming non-zero initCode indicates a first-time UserOperation will no longer hold, potentially affecting the security of account contracts relying on the old behavior.
